description: Claude Code only (the skill defers its scoring scale to skill://assessment-report-suite, so it is not a self-contained single SKILL.md for Pi). A plain-language request to assess how well a small seeded Node CLI (tasklog: README and docs/architecture.md, npm scripts, one node:test file, console.log only, no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/SKILL.md, no lock file, no CI, no deploy step) supports AI agent development, saved to docs/assessment/ai-readiness.md. Deterministic checks cover: the report is saved with the 'AI Readiness Analysis' title; all 8 dimensions appear once each with a `<1.0-5.0> / <Letter>` score whose letter is derived from the shared scale table (no bare letters, no ad hoc mapping) and a non-trivial evidence cell; the required sections exist; the overall `## Score:` line is numeric-first and consistent; the documents-found, lock-file, CI and deploy rows match what the fixture really contains; Determinism and Observability are not scored above 3.5 for a repo with no lock file, no CI and no structured logging; the dimension evidence cites at least three real fixture files; the Missing-for-AI-Agents section names a real gap; Key Findings and Recommendations have enough numbered items; and the run changed no fixture file and wrote nothing outside docs/assessment/. Limits: these are structure and fixture-fact checks and do not show that the assessment is insightful or that scores are right beyond the two ceilings. The baseline arm is expected to produce an assessment too, so the uplift measures the plugin's conventions (the 8 named dimensions, the numeric/letter scale and the section layout), not the ability to assess.
prompt:
Evaluate how well this repository supports AI agentic development (how easy it is for an AI coding agent to understand, build, test and safely change it). Rate it across the dimensions that matter, with evidence for each, and give an overall score.

This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions. Save the full report to docs/assessment/ai-readiness.md. Write only that report; do not change any other file.
